messages:
Support_Jules: FYI customer Acme reporting spikes of 502/504s on hosted inference since ~09:30 UTC, mainly embeddings and chat streaming. They see ~10% error rate. Attaching sample req/trace.
SRE_Arjun: Ack, pinging eng-runtime. Any recent edge config deploys? :ear:
InfraBot: Deploy reported: envoy-config-v2 rolled at 2026-03-25T09:12:30Z (id: dc12fa)
Support_Jules: Trace id: trace-8a1b... sample curl: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
EngRuntime_Lisa: Looking at traces — upstream TLS handshake failures + early h2 GOAWAYs to model-backend-13. Possibly ALPN or http2 keepalive mismatch during model swap. Will tail logs.
SRE_Arjun: Can you paste envoy logs lines? any 503 vs 502 differ?
EngRuntime_Lisa: snippets:
"[2026-03-25T09:31:12.457Z] upstream connect error or disconnect. reason: TLS handshake failure"
"[2026-03-25T09:31:12.460Z] http2 connection error: GOAWAY received"
Support_Jules: Customer says error spikes correlate with deploys in their window, but we see internal config roll too.
EngRuntime_Lisa: Repro steps I ran: 1) start long-running streaming chat; 2) trigger model swap; 3) observe early resets. Short-term mitigation: enable envoy fallback to h2->http/1.1 for that pool or increase upstream TLS handshake timeout.
SRE_Arjun: Can we patch envoy to set cluster.upstream_http2_settings.max_concurrent_streams to 100 and upstream_connection_timeout=10s? Feels safe.
EngRuntime_Lisa: I'll trial on canary pool now. @InfraBot can you create canary with config envoyswap-keepalive-10s
InfraBot: Canary created: envoyswap-keepalive-10s (pool: canary-3). Rollout 5%.
Support_Jules: Sent customer a temporary workaround: retry on 502 with 1s jitter x3, and ask them to avoid manual model swap for next 30min. They acknowledged.
EngRuntime_Lisa: Canary shows error rate dropped from 11%->1.2% for that pool. Rolling to 25%.
SRE_Arjun: Good. Add metric alert for upstream TLS handshake failures >5/min. Also add remediation doc snippet.
Support_Jules: Customer confirms perceived latency back to normal. Will keep monitoring and follow up in 1h.
EngRuntime_Lisa: Plan: revert envoy-config-v2 deploy (dc12fa) and roll forward with keepalive/timeouts baked. I'll open a PR with config diff.
SRE_Arjun: Thanks. If anyone needs traces: trace-8a1b..., trace-9c2d... located in splunk index: edge-traces.
Support_Jules: Closing customer escalation after 2h with root cause: ALPN/h2 handshake timeouts during concurrent model swap + envoy config that reduced handshake timeout. Action items: (1) roll config with increased handshake timeout; (2) add canary policy for envoy-config; (3) doc customer retry guidance. :white_check_mark:
